parameters.formDescription: Submit an AI-assisted draft for automated slop removal and broker-dealer compliance screening.

parameters.content:
ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
Goal: Pre-screen broker-dealer drafts for FINRA Rule 2210 / policy risks and strip AI slop before sending or escalating.
Input Schema: Document Type (text) and Draft Text (text) via form intake.
Model & Gating: Gemini model with strict JSON output, unpacked in JS, and routed by boolean compliance_flag into FLAGGED FOR COMPLIANCE REVIEW (true) or CLEARED FOR USE (false).
